subject: iframe error - embedding local html file

messages.author: b5b1760aab59ab85
messages.subject: iframe error - embedding local html file
parts:
I 'm working on a Shiny app that will (hopefully) write an HTML file and then embed that file via iframe.  The entire app's code is here: https://github.com/joebrew/ShinyApps/tree/master/sliv2.

The app runs perfectly on my local machine (feel free to test yourself by forking it), but fails when deployed to shinyapps.io.  I suspect that this has to do with http vs. https protocol, and how to actually point the iframe locally (as opposed to an external URL).  

The app deployed on shinyapss.io yields these errors: 

Failed to load resource: net::ERR_NAME_RESOLUTION_FAILED
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 405 (Method Not Allowed)

The specific lines in question in the server.R file are 140-150:
# Define path to html file
addResourcePath("library", paste0(root, "/www/index"))

# Render html leaflet map into iframe
output$help <- renderUI({
  tags$iframe(
    seamless="seamless",
    #src = "https://localhost://www/index/index.html", # doesn't work
    src="library/index.html",
    height = "600",
    width = "100%")
})

Any help is greatly appreciated.
